thread:
Irene: Quick follow-up from PM-814. We keep seeing weekday morning throughput spikes that blow the inference p99. Need SLO edits and clear owners for remediation.
Tom: Acknowledged. Pattern: 09:40-11:10 local leading to queue depth >80% and p99 tailing out.
Sofia: Proposed SLOs: latency p50=35ms, p90=110ms, p99=320ms (30d window). Also add a throughput SLO for control-plane: p95 >= 1150 rps.
Ravi: I can take remediation ownership: will implement router-level soft batch cap, autoscaler policy tweak (shorter cool-down), and an infra reservation for the 09:30-11:30 window for two weeks. Target PRs by 2024-06-10.
Irene: Good. Add a 6h and 24h burn-rate alert for the SLO and a short-term mitigation: spin up an extra GPU pool during the window.
ops-bot: RFC created: RFC-4678 linked to PM-814.
Tom: I'll own dashboards: add p99 1h/7d, burn-rate panels, and a request-size heatmap. Will post links.
Sofia: Also add batch-size conditional SLO: for batch>64 p99<=600ms. Helps catch regressions caused by batching.
Ravi: Action items:
 - Ravi: remediation PRs (autoscaler + router cap + infra reserve) due 2024-06-10
 - Tom: dashboards & alert rules due 2024-06-08
 - Sofia: update SLO docs and draft internal SLA note due 2024-06-12
Irene: Add a canary: Tom, can you schedule a 10m spike test at 1250rps during the window to validate autoscaler changes?
Tom: Yep, will schedule and collect metrics. If scale doesn't happen within 90s, we'll surface a test alert to the RFC (pager disabled).
Sofia: I'll also add regression tests in the eval harness for batch-size p99 regressions.
Ravi: Filed infra-reserve-258 and added note in RFC-4678. PRs upcoming.
Irene: Let's reconvene in 2 weeks for a follow-up. ops-bot: Reminder SLO-remediation-review on 2024-06-24 10:00 PST.
Tom: Dashboard links and alert diffs will be attached to RFC before EOD Friday.
Ravi: Opening PRs now, tagging reviewers.
Sofia: I'll finish the SLA note and share with sales/legal.
Irene: Thanks team. Keep RFC-4678 updated. :thumbsup:
